$m = (int)$data[$pos++];

    $x[$i] = (int)$data[$pos++];
    $y[$i] = (int)$data[$pos++];

$py = array_fill(0, $subsetCount, 0);
$nx = array_fill(0, $subsetCount, 0);
$ny = array_fill(0, $subsetCount, 0);

    for ($j = 0; $j < $n; ++$j) {
        if (($mask >> $j) & 1) {
            if ($x[$j] > 0) {
                $px[$mask] += abs($x[$j]);
            } else {
                $nx[$mask] += abs($x[$j]);
            }

            if ($y[$j] > 0) {
                $py[$mask] += abs($y[$j]);
            } else {
                $ny[$mask] += abs($y[$j]);
            }
        }
    }
}

for ($mask = 0; $mask < $subsetCount; ++$mask) {
    $signature = $px[$mask] . ',' . $nx[$mask] . ',' . $py[$mask] . ',' . $ny[$mask];

    if (isset($transitionCounts[$signature])) {
        ++$transitionCounts[$signature][4];
    } else {
        $transitionCounts[$signature] = [
            $px[$mask],
            $nx[$mask],
            $py[$mask],
            $ny[$mask],
            1

    }

$dp = [0 => 1];

    $targetBit = ($m >> $bit) & 1;

        $by = $key & 1;
        $key >>= 1;
        $bx = $key & 1;
        $key >>= 1;

        $cny = $key % BASE;
        $key = intdiv($key, BASE);
        $cpy = $key % BASE;
        $key = intdiv($key, BASE);

            $cx = $npx & 1;
            $cy = $npy & 1;

            $newBx = ($cx === $targetBit) ? $bx : (($cx > $targetBit) ? 1 : 0);

            $npy >>= 1;

class FastScanner
{
    private $data;
    private $length;
    private $position = 0;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->data = file_get_contents("php://stdin");
        $this->length = strlen($this->data);
    }

    public function nextInt()
    {
        while ($this->position < $this->length) {
            $c = ord($this->data[$this->position]);
            if (($c >= 48 && $c <= 57) || $c === 45) {
                break;
            }
            ++$this->position;
        }

        $sign = 1;
        if ($this->position < $this->length && $this->data[$this->position] === '-') {
            $sign = -1;
            ++$this->position;
        }

        $value = 0;
        while ($this->position < $this->length) {
            $c = ord($this->data[$this->position]);
            if ($c < 48 || $c > 57) {
                break;
            }
            $value = $value * 10 + $c - 48;
            ++$this->position;
        }

        return $value * $sign;
    }
}

source_data.prob_desc_description: You are given $$$n$$$ pairwise non-collinear two-dimensional vectors. You can make shapes in the two-dimensional plane with these vectors in the following fashion: Start at the origin $$$(0, 0)$$$. Choose a vector and add the segment of the vector to the current point. For example, if your current point is at $$$(x, y)$$$ and you choose the vector $$$(u, v)$$$, draw a segment from your current point to the point at $$$(x + u, y + v)$$$ and set your current point to $$$(x + u, y + v)$$$. Repeat step 2 until you reach the origin again.You can reuse a vector as many times as you want.Count the number of different, non-degenerate (with an area greater than $$$0$$$) and convex shapes made from applying the steps, such that the shape can be contained within a $$$m \times m$$$ square, and the vectors building the shape are in counter-clockwise fashion. Since this number can be too large, you should calculate it by modulo $$$998244353$$$.Two shapes are considered the same if there exists some parallel translation of the first shape to another.A shape can be contained within a $$$m \times m$$$ square if there exists some parallel translation of this shape so that every point $$$(u, v)$$$ inside or on the border of the shape satisfies $$$0 \leq u, v \leq m$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Output a single integer  — the number of satisfiable shapes by modulo $$$998244353$$$.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$m$$$  — the number of vectors and the size of the square ($$$1 \leq n \leq 5$$$, $$$1 \leq m \leq 10^9$$$). Each of the next $$$n$$$ lines contains two integers $$$x_i$$$ and $$$y_i$$$  — the $$$x$$$-coordinate and $$$y$$$-coordinate of the $$$i$$$-th vector ($$$|x_i|, |y_i| \leq 4$$$, $$$(x_i, y_i) \neq (0, 0)$$$). It is guaranteed, that no two vectors are parallel, so for any two indices $$$i$$$ and $$$j$$$ such that $$$1 \leq i < j \leq n$$$, there is no real value $$$k$$$ such that $$$x_i \cdot k = x_j$$$ and $$$y_i \cdot k = y_j$$$.
